name: Galvanic Field
mechanics: When Actus repairs another unit, that unit immediately attacks a target in range.
The triggered attack uses a level-dependent percentage of the unit's damage and has a per-hit damage cap.
Actus can repair another Mechanical unit even when it is at full health.
breakpoint_notes: Value requires another friendly Mechanical unit with a target in range when repaired.
